verdict.rationale: Daily documents its own server-side control surface: a REST API to create rooms, manage tokens, trigger recordings and control calls from a server. It also publishes an OpenAPI spec and lets servers react to call events, so parts of the product can be driven without a UI. Nothing shows a headless client or participant, CI integration, or a CLI, so 'run in CI' is only implied by API availability. Missing for 10: a documented headless client/bot runtime, CI/CD usage guidance or tooling, a CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated headless use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Create rooms, manage tokens, trigger recordings, and control calls from your server.
React to call events server-side — participant joins, recordings complete, and more.
To start recording automatically when a token holder joins, use the [`start_cloud_recording`]
